Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
In continuation with our letter dated September 1, 2026, we wish to inform you that the audio 
recording of Q1 FY 2026-27 Earnings Call held on Friday, September 4, 2026, in respect of 
the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the 
quarter ended June 30, 2026 is available on the Company's website at following link : 
 
Link: Audio Recording of Earnings Call Q1 FY 2026-27. 
 
We request you to kindly take the same on record.  
 
For Dhoot Transmission Limited
